    i=j=0
    out=[]

def solve(data):
    class Node:
        def __init__(self,v): self.v=v; self.n=None
    nodes=[Node(v) for v in data["values"]]
    for a,b in zip(nodes,nodes[1:]): a.n=b
    if not nodes: return None
    if data["pos"]>=0: nodes[-1].n=nodes[data["pos"]]
    slow=fast=nodes[0]
    while fast and fast.n:
        slow=slow.n; fast=fast.n.n
        if slow is fast:
            entry=nodes[0]
            while entry is not slow: entry=entry.n; slow=slow.n
            return entry.v
    return None

    reach=0
    for i,x in enumerate(data):
        if i>reach: return False
        reach=max(reach,i+x)
    return True
